variants.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Subject: the physical journey of geological drill cuttings, FOUR distinct readable zones from left to right: 1 small cutaway geological block with compact red drilling rig and actual broken fragments at the bit; 2 returned muddy fragments on a shaker screen next to wash bowls and sample bags with entirely blank tags; 3 an enlarged observation workbench with three dishes of sandstone, dark mudstone and pale limestone fragments and a stereo microscope; 4 a tidy analytical work area with mixed grain tray beside separate grain dishes and a blank open notebook. Four zones connected by continuous paper base, balanced levels, restrained scale. Macro coherent whole, not icons or boxed steps. Do not draw words, letters, numbers, graphs, measured curves, arrows, floating screens, oil refinery, pipelines unrelated to sample handling. Full scene fits entirely in frame with margins. High material quality, no cartoon toy shine, no neon, no visual clutter. This locates later text only; it must not pretend to be scientific data.
